resolved_draft_findings: Sixteen explicit propositions include exact SQL and identity admission, negative witnesses, reachable admitted statements/portals and immutable Bind capture.
Canonical proxy endpoint validation covers environment/explicit DSNs, multi-host/service/hostaddr escapes and disables direct TCP.
Production-based opaque statement detection includes nested forms and procedures.
UTF8/standard string mode restrictions apply before pipelined forwarding with backend status monitoring.
Resource budget specifies parser concurrency, handshake/frame deadlines and per-connection statement metadata bounds.
Conservative state semantics and explicit engine trust avoid claims of faithful PostgreSQL success or effect analysis.
Reserved cancellation startup slots, separate client-path counter deltas, partial constraint repair and unresolved root-license provenance are explicit in final revision3.
implementation_acceptance_notes: Preserve real pg_dump/pg_restore and fresh/upgrade/partial migration tests. Fix independently missing paired constraints and use one migration helper; aggregate counters alone are not evidence of complete routing, so isolate each client path.
Make cancellation work at session/parser saturation and validate protocol/COPY/auth phases, malformed packet bodies and backend errors.
Strict JSON parsing, streamed output bounds, process cleanup, stdin-only SQL, warm-cache binary tamper denial and finite queue behavior remain runtime checks.
Test portal suspension, statement replacement after Bind, failed Parse/Bind, transaction completion and unnamed invalidation; the model proves admission provenance, not all server lifecycle states.
No commercial/redistribution clearance is conferred. Preserve missing root-license status and avoid distributing unrelated fixture corpora.

formal_evidence_observed.required_before_implementation: As planned after all six design seats, regenerate the proof report against final revision3 before implementation. Existing draft evidence is not represented as final closure.
